title: Risk profile (per user)
description: The per-user risk limits the engine sizes and gates against. Stored as one jsonb document keyed by user_id (executor.risk_profiles), not as columns, so this contract is the only description of the shape. EVERY percentage here is a decimal string, and the repo's own Rust-side type carries the same rule with an explicit comment ('percentage fields are decimal strings'). Thresholds are NOT clamped on write - a negative or absurd limit is refused with a field-named error, never silently corrected (the settings route's stated rule). Defaults come from DEFAULT_RISK_PROFILE in apps/web/src/platform/executor/types.ts.

default_risk.description: Read according to default_risk_mode: money when risk_usd, percentage when risk_percent.

max_daily_loss_pct.description: Gates new executions against realized P&L for the day (runtime.ts daily-loss gate).
